IB 2027 · HL

Unit 9: Agents & Neural Computing

Theme A4.3 | 3 Weeks

Unit overview

Can we build a brain?

This unit covers 4 IB Computer Science sub-topics: A4.3.8, A4.3.9, A4.3.10, and A4.3.11.

The focus areas are ANNs (Neural Networks), CNNs (Convolutional NNs), Model Selection, and CNNs (Convolutional Neural Networks).

Coverage

  • A4.3.8 ANNs (Neural Networks)
  • A4.3.9 CNNs (Convolutional NNs)
  • A4.3.10 Model Selection
  • A4.3.11 CNNs (Convolutional Neural Networks)

Objectives and outcomes

Code What You Will Learn What You Should Be Able To Do
A4.3.8 ANNs (Neural Networks) Outline structure/function of ANNs and multi-layer networks.
A4.3.9 CNNs (Convolutional NNs) Describe how CNNs learn spatial hierarchies in images.
A4.3.10 Model Selection Explain importance of model selection and comparison.
A4.3.11 CNNs (Convolutional Neural Networks) Explain how convolution, pooling, and spatial feature extraction are used in CNNs for image tasks.
